method: leave-one-day-out: hyperparameters selected on a different training day, every station on the held-out day predicted from the other stations that day; day is the unit of replication
headline: Leave-one-day-out over 318 days of broadcast SPP: the distance kernel predicts an unseen day's receiver clocks 52% better than no network (95% CI [50, 54], 100% of days) and 7% better than a bulk network mean; lambda* median 7000 km, selected on separate training days.
